title: MN transcriptomic signature: analysis code and result tables
description:
Analysis code, harmonised metadata and result tables for a compartment-resolved glomerular transcriptomic signature and a four-gene classifier for membranous nephropathy (MN). The pipeline de-duplicates 13 public GEO accessions at patient level into seven non-redundant cohort sets, then performs differential expression and random-effects meta-analysis, a separability gate, WGCNA, single-cell deconvolution, panel selection and external validation, and a leakage-audited benchmark of published MN panels.

Research use only. The four-gene panel is a discrimination instrument, not a validated diagnostic or prognostic test, and requires per-platform recalibration.
